description: This file contains unit tests for the HdmiInput plugin/module using Google Test framework. It defines various test classes and functions to verify the behavior of HDMI input handling, including device discovery, EDID reading/writing, HDMI signal status, video mode updates, and event subscriptions. The tests mock dependencies and simulate events to validate correct responses and event handling logic.

classes.name: HdmiInputTest
classes.description: Base test class for HDMI input plugin tests, initializing core plugin, handlers, and connection.

classes.name: HdmiInputDsTest
classes.description: Derived test class that mocks the HDMI input implementation and tests device enumeration and EDID read/write.

classes.name: HdmiInputInitializedTest
classes.description: Extends HdmiInputTest with mocks for IARM bus and event registration, setting up event handler subscriptions.

classes.name: HdmiInputInitializedEventTest
classes.description: Further extension adding event dispatcher setup and factory assignment, for testing event notifications.

classes.name: HdmiInputInitializedEventDsTest
classes.description: Mocked environment for detailed event testing, including HDMI status and signal change events, video mode updates, and event callbacks.
